verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de documents webhooks: you register a webhook URL in the dashboard under /webhooks, get real-time notifications when notarization events complete, and can verify payloads with HMAC-SHA256 signatures. Named events such as `appointment.completed` are documented. Missing for 10: programmatic (API-based) webhook subscription management, since registration is shown only via the dashboard; a complete event catalog beyond isolated examples; independent or hands-on corroboration.
